Walking HR chart frames need 步行心率 or 步行平均心率 — not 静息心率 on dedicated walking HR trend screenshots. Resting HR baseline frames belong on the Resting Heart Rate listing guide — not mixed into walking HR captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Walking HR vs threshold alerts

Walking heart-rate trend charts (步行心率趋势) differ from High Heart Rate notification enrollment (高心率通知) and Low Heart Rate notification enrollment (低心率通知). Walking HR chart frames need 步行心率 or 步行心率记录 — not 心率过高 or 心率过低 on dedicated walking HR trend screenshots. Threshold-alert frames belong on the High Heart Rate or Low Heart Rate listing guides — not mixed into walking HR captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Walking Heart Rate listing copy covers average HR while walking — 步行心率 / 步行平均心率 / 步行心率记录. Resting Heart Rate listing copy covers baseline resting HR during inactivity — 静息心率 / 安静心率 / 静息心率趋势 / 静息心率记录.
